title: Empty Search
description: A customer opens the booking wizard's address field and hasn't typed anything yet. The autocomplete shouldn't dump the entire hub list at them.
successCondition: GET /api/booking/geocode with no q query parameter at all, and separately with q set to an empty string, both return 200 with results equal to an empty array [].
hints: This endpoint requires no authentication at all — test it with a bare, unauthenticated request.
Test the missing-parameter case and the explicit-empty-string case as two separate requests; they're documented as behaving the same way, but that's worth confirming independently.
